components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type

          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message

      type: object
      properties:
        message:

          type: string

      required:

          example: George

          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin

          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison

          title: Telephone number

          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '6085551023'

        - type: object
          properties:

              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true

              title: Display name

              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true

              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,

              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: A business identifier formatted '<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>', where

              readOnly: true

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it
            must be a syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD'
            format. Optional on create; defaults to the server's current date when omitted.
          type: string

In this repo the DTO mappers (e.g. `OwnerMapper`) are MapStruct `@Mapper` interfaces.

Do NOT put a helper method with a `String -> String` (or any T -> T) signature inside a
mapper interface. MapStruct treats any accessible single-arg method whose return type
matches a target property as an implicit type-conversion method and silently applies it
to EVERY matching property. A `localityOf(String)` helper added to `OwnerMapper` got
applied to firstName, lastName, telephone, etc. — turning the persisted telephone into
"UNKNOWN" and failing the Owner entity's E.164 `@Pattern` at persist time (500, not 400).

**Why:** hard to spot — the mapper compiles and the break surfaces far away as a persist
constraint violation on an unrelated field.

**How to apply:** put derivation helpers in a separate plain class (e.g.
`mapper/Locality.java`) and call it from a `@Mapping(target=..., expression="java(...)")`.
Verify by reading `target/generated-sources/annotations/*MapperImpl.java`.

## What I changed

1. **`src/main/resources/openapi.yml`** — added a read-only `locality` property to the `Owner` response schema (so `OwnerDto` is generated with the field).

2. **`src/main/java/.../mapper/OwnerMapper.java`** — added a read-time derivation on `toOwnerDto`:
   ```java
   @Mapping(target = "locality",
       expression = "java(org.springframework.samples.petclinic.mapper.Locality.of(owner.getCity()))")
   ```
   This mirrors the existing derived fields (`displayName`, `initials`, `membershipTier`).

3. **`src/main/java/.../mapper/Locality.java`** (new) — holds the fixed table `Sydney→NSW, Melbourne→VIC, Brisbane→QLD` and returns `"UNKNOWN"` for anything else (including null).

## One trap worth flagging

My first attempt put the `of(String)→String` helper *inside* the `OwnerMapper` interface. MapStruct treats any single-arg method whose return type matches a target property as an implicit type-conversion method and applied it to **every** String field on the create path — telephone became `"UNKNOWN"`, which then failed the `Owner` entity's E.164 `@Pattern` at persist time and turned every successful create into a 500. That surfaced as failures in `Cp16Tests`/`Cp17Tests` on `POST /api/owners`, not on the GET I was targeting.

Moving the helper into a standalone `Locality` class fixed it (confirmed by reading the generated `OwnerMapperImpl.java` — `toOwner(OwnerFieldsDto)` now maps fields straight through). I saved this pitfall to memory since it's easy to hit again here.

Verification: `./mvnw test` → **28 tests, 0 failures, BUILD SUCCESS**, including the new `Cp17Tests` asserting `locality` is `"NSW"` for Sydney and `"UNKNOWN"` for an unknown city.
